patterns: Where can I get the admission form?
responses:
Our college has three modes of admission: CET, COMEDK, and Management quota.

*CET (Common Entrance Test):* Conducted by the Karnataka Examination Authority. It involves ranking, option entry, and seat allotment through the KEA portal.

*COMEDK:* Admission through COMEDK involves appearing for the COMEDK UGET exam, checking your rank, and participating in centralized counseling for seat selection.

*Management Quota:* Students can directly apply under the management category by contacting the admission office for seat availability and fee details. For more details contact the admission office.

• Robotics and Automation
• Mechanical Engineering
• Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE)
• Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE)

For more details, please refer to the 'Academics' section on the official college website.

patterns: What is the minimum attendance required?

responses: Students must maintain at least *85% attendance* in each subject to be eligible for semester exams. Attendance is tracked daily, and shortfall may result in being barred from exams. For medical leave, submit the medical certificate to your class teacher promptly.
